handling.title: What is airport handling?
handling.definition: In the aeronautical field, the term handling refers to the set of assistance services carried out at the airport to facilitate aircraft operations. These services cover different activities related to the aircraft, passengers, baggage and cargo, from their arrival at the airport until their departure. Handling makes it possible to coordinate the necessary processes for the movement of passengers, baggage and goods between air and ground transport, as well as connections between aircraft on transit flights. In short, it is the entire set of activities that make it possible for an airport operation to develop in a coordinated, safe and efficient manner.
